Return value:
None
Exception Safety:
exception safe
Thread Safety:
not thread-safe
Description:
Sends out the current log buffer and initiates a new message stream.
Note:
Calling ara::log::LogStream::Flush is only necessary if the ara::log::LogStream
object is going to be re-used within the same scope. Otherwise, if the object goes out of scope
(e.g. end of function block) then the flushing operation will be done internally by the destructor. It
is important to note that the ara::log::LogStream::Flush command does not empty the
buffer, but it forwards the buffer’s current contents to the Logging framework.
⌋
